title: Don't Prompt Your Agents. Equip Them: Skillware as a Modular Standard for Sovereign, Auditable, and Deterministic Capability Execution for Logical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.07652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current autonomous logical systems rely on a fragile assumption: that language models should dynamically write code, guess API payloads, and memorize operational constraints through prompt engineering. In practice, this burns massive context windows, inflates API bills, and produces brittle agents that fail unpredictably in production.   In this work, we present Skillware, an open architectural framework and capability registry that formally separates what an agent wants to do from how that task is executed. Instead of prompting models with loose text instructions or markdown files baptized as 'skills', Skillware equips them with modular, versioned software capability bundles. Much like skill hotkeys in video games that execute deterministically under fixed world rules, each bundle combines a typed JSON input contract, deterministic Python code, task directives, bundled datasets, and automated unit tests. translated_abstract: 当前的自主逻辑系统依赖于一个脆弱的假设：语言模型应该动态编写代码、猜测API载荷，并通过提示工程来记忆操作约束。在实践中，这种方式会大量消耗上下文窗口、推高API费用，并产生在生产环境中不可预测地失效的脆弱智能体。在本工作中，我们提出了Skillware，一个开放的架构框架和能力注册表，它正式地将智能体“想要做什么”与“任务如何执行”分离开来。Skillware不是用松散的文本指令或被美其名曰“技能”的markdown文件来提示模型，而是为智能体配备模块化、版本化的软件能力包。就像视频游戏中的技能快捷键在固定世界规则下确定性地执行一样，每个能力包都结合了类型化的JSON输入契约、确定性的Python代码、任务指令、捆绑的数据集以及自动化单元测试。进程内适配器将……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Skillware开放框架，通过模块化、版本化的软件能力包（包含类型化JSON契约、确定性代码、任务指令、数据集和单元测试）取代脆弱的提示工程，将智能体的意图与执行正式分离，实现主权、可审计且确定性的能力执行。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Skillware, an open framework that formally separates what an agent wants to do from how tasks are executed, replacing fragile prompt engineering with modular, versioned software capability bundles to achieve sovereign, auditable, and deterministic capability execution.
